stage_number.description: Chronological sequence number of the stage, starting from 1
stage_number.title: Stage Number

stage_name.description: Name of the stage (e.g. Stage 1: Initial Access / Malicious LNK)
stage_name.title: Stage Name

description.description: Technical breakdown and analysis of actions observed in this stage
description.title: Description

key_techniques.description: Primary attack techniques employed in this stage
key_techniques.title: Key Techniques

tools_and_artifacts.description: Loaders, malware, RATs, native utilities (LOLBins), scripts, or tools used
tools_and_artifacts.title: Tools And Artifacts

procedures.description: Granular procedure execution details (commands run, registry modified, etc.)
procedures.title: Procedures

infrastructure_c2.description: Associated IP, domain, protocol, port, user-agent, or beaconing profile if relevant
infrastructure_c2.title: Infrastructure C2

tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK Tactic (e.g. TA0001 - Initial Access)
tactic.title: Tactic

technique_name.description: MITRE ATT&CK Technique Name (e.g. Spearphishing Attachment)
technique_name.title: Technique Name

procedure_description.description: Specific procedure or implementation observed in the campaign
procedure_description.title: Procedure Description

file_hashes.description: SHA256, MD5, SHA1 hashes of payloads or artifacts
file_hashes.title: File Hashes

domains.description: Associated C2 or staging domain names
domains.title: Domains

c2_servers.description: C2 URLs, ports, or listener configs
c2_servers.title: C2 Servers

file_paths_or_registry.description: Notable dropper paths, persistence keys, or artifact filesystem locations
file_paths_or_registry.title: File Paths Or Registry

detection_rules.description: References to YARA, Sigma, or Snort detection rules
detection_rules.title: Detection Rules

title.description: Title of the research report or threat intelligence analysis
title.title: Title

source.description: Source organization or blog (e.g. The DFIR Report, Unit 42, SentinelOne Labs)
source.title: Source

url.description: Original URL or citation for the intelligence
url.title: Url

date.description: Publication date or intrusion discovery date (YYYY-MM-DD or formatted string)
date.title: Date

type.description: Type of resource (Infection Chain, Attack Chain, Intrusion Timeline, Technique Deep Dive, Emulation Playbook, Simulation Scenario)
type.title: Type

threat_actor_or_malware.description: Named threat groups, APTs, ransomware affiliates, or malware families involved
threat_actor_or_malware.title: Threat Actor Or Malware

named_stages.description: List of stage names in order (e.g. ['Stage 1: Phishing & Malicious ISO', 'Stage 2: Loader Execution'])
named_stages.title: Named Stages

stages.description: Detailed technical breakdown of each attack stage
stages.title: Stages

attack_flow_diagram.description: Mermaid diagram or structured ASCII/text diagram illustrating the end-to-end chain
attack_flow_diagram.title: Attack Flow Diagram

mitre_attack_mappings.description: Granular MITRE ATT&CK tactic, technique, and procedure mappings
mitre_attack_mappings.title: Mitre Attack Mappings

notable_iocs.description: Structured Indicators of Compromise (hashes, IPs, domains, paths)

summary.description: Concise narrative summary of the intrusion from initial access to final objective
summary.title: Summary

emulation_utility.description: Strategic analysis on how this chain can be converted into an adversary emulation plan, Atomic Red Team tests, or Caldera abilities
emulation_utility.title: Emulation Utility
